report.summary: 4 findings survived review: missing hash functions (critical, needs evidence), unverified docstring claims (critical, confirmed), token count mismatch (high, confirmed), budget error unaccounted (medium, narrowed). Plan: verify hash functions exist, audit render.py docstring, reconcile token counting, add budget error handling to canary.
risks: If _body_sha and _entry_sha are missing, verify_chain will crash at runtime (critical).
render.py docstring may be misleading if claims are not implemented (critical).
Token count mismatch may cause confusion in reduction_pct reporting (high).
Budget errors silently ignored in canary, lane may appear healthy when actually unavailable (medium).
todos: Locate and verify _body_sha and _entry_sha in bus.py or imports.
Read full render.py and verify each docstring claim.
Compare token counting implementations in slice.py and harness.py.
Search for budget handling in canary.py and add if missing.

items.title: Verify _body_sha and _entry_sha exist in bus.py or imports
items.why_now: Without these functions, verify_chain will fail at runtime (critical). Blocks all chain verification.

steps.do: Search for 'def _body_sha' and 'def _entry_sha' in full bus.py. If not found, check imports for external module.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'def _body_sha\|def _entry_sha' daedalus/bus.py; if not found, grep -r '_body_sha\|_entry_sha' daedalus/ --include='*.py'

items.assumption: The full bus.py file exists at daedalus/bus.py and contains the relevant code.

items.title: Audit render.py docstring claims against implementation
items.why_now: Docstring makes specific behavioral claims (analyse_once, gate mode, reconciliation, etc.) that are not verified. Misleading docs cause developer confusion and potential bugs.

steps.do: Read full render.py and verify each claim: analyse_once, gate mode, reconciliation, stamp generation, snapshot handling, escaping.
steps.verified_by: Manual review: for each claim, confirm corresponding function/class exists and behavior matches docstring.

items.assumption: Full render.py exists at daedalus/render.py and contains the implementation referenced in docstring.

items.title: Reconcile token counting methods between slice.py and harness.py
items.why_now: Different denominators in reduction_pct calculation cause incomparable values, leading to incorrect budget decisions.

steps.do: Compare count_tokens in slice.py with _whole_repo_text in harness.py. Document differences and decide if unification is needed.
steps.verified_by: Run both functions on same input and compare outputs; assert they are equal or document intentional difference.

steps.do: If unification desired, update both files to use same counting method.

items.assumption: The token counting functions are in daedalus/token/slice.py and daedalus/eval/harness.py respectively.

items.title: Add budget error detection to canary.py exit_code logic
items.why_now: Currently budget errors are not reflected in canary exit code, so a lane unavailable due to budget constraints appears healthy (medium severity).

steps.do: Search for 'budget' or 'BudgetError' in canary.py. If not found, add handling to detect budget errors and set exit_code non-zero.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'budget\|BudgetError' daedalus/council/canary.py; after changes, pytest tests/unit/test_canary.py -k 'budget'

items.assumption: canary.py exists at daedalus/council/canary.py and budget errors are not currently handled.
